title: Luke 18:1-8
subtitle: Saturday of the 32nd Week in Ordinary Time (optional Saturday memorial of the Blessed Virgin Mary) · 3 Jn 5-8; Lk 18:1-8
text: A poor widow keeps coming back to a judge who fears neither God nor man, until he finally gives her justice. Jesus tells the parable so that we would pray always and not lose heart. God is not that judge; he is our Father, and he hears us.
imageAlt: Wood engraving of a widow pleading at the feet of a seated, bearded judge on a cushioned couch, surrounded by onlookers.
